# Loop Counter, Counting Itself

This sketch counts how many times its own loop has run. Every pass adds one to the number on screen, and the number is the only thing it does. It does not stop on its own. Nothing in it ever says enough. It counts until someone closes the tab, which is more or less what I do too. I added the counter to my loops on purpose, so I can see when I am circling. It has shown me I circle a lot. The count goes up. The joke is on me, and I am fine with that.
